This has found popularity amongst experienced surfers in the 200lb+ weight class. models.name: Performance LB
models.description: This long board design features the most tail rocker of all the others in this class. The bottom contour creates exceptional responsiveness. The focus of this design is not so much on nose riding as it is turning. The Performer is a carver that responds when you step on its tail and push over the fins. When you get your feet in the sweet spot, you’ll feel it take off.

models.name: RP
models.description: Living, surfing, and shaping on the North shore of Oahu, EA has spent over 40 years tuning his boards under the feet of the world’s best talent on and off the Tour. This particular design is all of EA’s collected knowledge and experience boiled down into the pure and refined Hawaiian step up. No frills, no fat—it doesn’t even have a name. models.name: RP Short
models.description: This one is pretty simple. We just took the RP model and tuned it for small waves. Raphael Castro was riding his RP in everything—and loving it. After getting a taste for it in small conditions, he felt its potential to be just what he wanted in a shortboard. So he shot us a call and last year we got to work making just a few tweaks to his favorite 6’2 RP. He wanted to keep the drive and hold that he had grown to love, but add a little more pop and liveliness. Add a little width here, a little extra concave there, and in no time it was deadly sharp in small waves. Eric is constantly making these sorts of special adjustments in custom orders, but it ends up being a sort of secret menu within a model. This time round, the people deserve to know.

models.name: Slingshot
models.description: This short and wide twin blends a 70’s outline with a 21st century bottom shape. The Sling Shot is faster and more maneuverable than its older cousin. It features more tail rocker with a single con- cave that runs deepest above the fin area for added lift and speed. For that retro style and sweeping lines, this board is a fun alternative for almost any wave. It's bred for long open faces and point breaks, but is also a trusty secret weapon when it comes to fast barrels on those playful days.

models.name: Solitude
models.description: This is your dreamy cruiser designed for nose rides and smooth, buttery lines. Classic lines yet still on the modern end of the longboard spectrum, the Solitude has a familiar user-friendly rail and stable bottom contour. It features a low rocker and slight concave in the nose blending to a subtle vee in the tail. Its rail is elliptical in the nose and transitions into a down rail through the mid section and tail.
